During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''battle''' was fought over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]]. One [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was killed in the battle when its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was shot down.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle is only mentioned in the opening pages of the Clone Wars novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', during a reminiscence by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Jai Maruk]]. The Jedi, the ship they piloted, and the general details of the battle are not elaborated upon further.
